map.输入紫外线指数（UV Index，0–16），查询风险等级、防护建议与不同肤色的: Enter the UV Index (0-16) to look up the risk level, protection advice and sunburn time for different skin types
map.📖 查看「紫外线指数防护 使用指南」: 📖 View the "UV Index Protection User Guide"
map.紫外线指数分档：0 至 2 低、3 至 5 中等、6 至 7 高、8 至 10: UV Index bands: 0-2 low, 3-5 moderate, 6-7 high, 8-10 very high, 11+ extreme; protection advice is to use SPF 15+ when the index is at least 3, and SPF 30+ reapplied every 2 hours when at least 8; unprotected sunburn time is about 200 ÷ (index × skin factor) minutes (type I factor about 3, type II about 2, type III about 1, type IV about 0.7).
map.I 极敏感（白皙·雀斑·易晒伤）: I Very sensitive (fair, freckles, burns easily)
map.💡 紫外线指数由地面 UV 辐射强度计算，11+ 为极高。晒伤时间为未防护状态下: 💡 The UV Index is computed from ground-level UV radiation intensity; 11+ is extreme. Sunburn time is the estimated duration for skin redness to appear without protection, and in practice is affected by altitude, cloud cover and reflection.
map.快速查询，结果可一键复制: quick lookup; the result can be copied in one click
map.晒伤时间估算公式：t（分钟）≈ K / UV，K 取决于肤色: Sunburn time estimation formula: t (minutes) ≈ K / UV, where K depends on skin type
map.水面、雪地、沙地反射可使有效 UV 上升 20%–80%: Reflection from water, snow and sand can raise the effective UV by 20%-80%
map.防晒霜应每 2 小时补涂，游泳出汗后即时补涂: Reapply sunscreen every 2 hours, and immediately after swimming or sweating
map.对防雷/防风/防洪设施做合规点检算达成率。: Run a compliance check on lightning/wind/flood protection facilities to compute the achievement rate.
map.按达成率评防护等级。: Grade the protection level by the achievement rate.
map.应防护点 25、达标 22 → 达成率=22/25×100=88%，评级「基本合: 25 points to protect, 22 up to standard → achievement rate = 22/25×100=88%, rated "basically qualified" (75-89%), the remaining 3 points to be rectified within a deadline.
map.达成率≥90 合格、75–89 基本合格、60–74 需整改、<60 不合格，与: Achievement rate ≥90 qualified, 75-89 basically qualified, 60-74 needs rectification, <60 unqualified, the same framework as lightning protection compliance.
map.汛前/雷季前必检，台风多发的季度加密，灾后复检。: Mandatory before the flood/thunderstorm season, more frequent in typhoon-prone quarters, and re-checked after disasters.
map.基本合格能运营吗？: Can operations continue while basically qualified?
map.可但须限期整改未达标点，重大风险点不合格应停用。: Yes, but non-compliant points must be rectified within a deadline; if a major risk point is non-compliant, it should be shut down.
map.根据世界卫生组织紫外线指数分级，给出风险等级、防晒霜、衣物、遮阴与暴露时限建议，: Based on the World Health Organization UV Index grading, it gives risk levels and advice on sunscreen, clothing, shade and exposure time, and estimates the time for sunburn erythema to appear without protection for the six Fitzpatrick skin types. Runs purely on the front end; data is not uploaded.
